Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 3 by misinterpreting the historical timeline of the "tallest building outside North America" title. The Planner incorrectly assumed that because the Petronas Towers (Kuala Lumpur) became the world's tallest in 1998, they were the immediate successor to One Raffles Place (which held the title until 1989). This is a factual error: the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong (completed 1989) was the actual successor that surpassed One Raffles Place in 1989. The Petronas Towers surpassed the Bank of China Tower later. By prioritizing the Petronas Towers as the answer in Step 3, the Planner introduced a false conclusion that contradicted the correct historical data (Bank of China Tower) which had already been identified in previous steps. This error persisted despite the WebSurfer providing correct information about the Bank of China Tower in earlier steps.
